apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- GS: give the shipped filters' overshoot in the clamp's comment
- Android: Texture Upscaling is Off, RAISR 2x or RAISR 4x
- Qt: Texture Upscaling is Off, RAISR 2x or RAISR 4x
- GS: texture upscaling is one PS2-trained filter set, run once or twice
- MSVC: list GSTexelAddressedDraw.h in pcsx2.vcxproj
- Resources: add the PS2-trained RAISR filter set
- GS: take the whole texel at a hard alpha edge in a generated upscale
- GS: keep hard alpha edges exact in a generated upscale
- GS: draw the guest's own texels where a draw reads a texture as swatches
- GS: take a generated upscale's alpha range from its source texels
- GS: clamp upscaled texels to the range of the source texels they come from
- Android: add RAISR 4x Smooth to the texture upscaling picker
- Qt: add RAISR 4x (Smooth) to the Texture Upscaling combo
- GS: add a RAISR 4x (Smooth) texture upscaling mode
- Android: add the texture upscaling picker to the Renderer tab
- Qt: add a Texture Upscaling combo to the Texture Replacement tab
- Tests: unit tests for the texture upscaler's queue and mip chain
- GS: upscale textures in the background and feed them in as a generated pack
- iOS: bundle the texture upscaler's filter sets
- GS: add the TextureUpscaleMode setting
- GS: use std::fma in the RAISR engine so MSVC ARM64 builds
- Tests: unit tests for the RAISR upscaler engine
- GS: add a RAISR 2x upscaler engine for RGBA8 textures
- Resources: add Intel RAISR 2x filter sets for the texture upscaler
- GS/TC: unswizzle target updates into the scratch buffer, not mapped upload memory
- GS/TC: test what Target::Update uploads for each dirty rectangle
- Android: show that the shader preset picker is scanning
- Android: index shader presets once instead of on every picker open
- GS: take a pack texture's alpha near 0x80 as 0x80 under an opaque alpha test
- GS: make SyncWorkerThread wait for the pack worker's current job
- GS: take the replacement-cache mutex when cancelling pending pack loads
- GS/TC: let a replacement injected after its placeholder was evicted age out

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261005...46c06fe7ca0f1cbe94aab8b27db2a35a2330b3d5
